messages:
sophia: quick heads-up — saw a short ECC correctable spike in apac-pool7 at ~08:10 UTC. ~40 cards with bursts, not widespread yet. want to sanity-check thresholds before any auto-evac.
jamie: saw graphs, same window. Xid error rate hasn't jumped globally but 3 hosts showed transient PCIe resets. logged a screenshot: https://ops.internal/snap/abc123 :eyes:
taylor: current policy: per-card soft-drain at 50 correctables / 5m, hard-evict at 200 / 30m; per-host N+1 fallback kicks in at 500 / 5m. those nums were conservative and might be noisy for apac pools.
sophia: thinking we should fuse signals (ECC + Xid + pci_resets + disconnects) and use a staged ordering to avoid knee-jerk replacements. propose a signal-fusion score and a 3-step evacuation:
  1) soft-drain (stop new allocations, let existing jobs finish; keep preemptible burst capacity)
  2) isolate card (remove from scheduler but keep host up for reruns)
  3) replace slot (RMA/hot-swap) if persistent after timeframe
jamie: agreed. also want host-level hysteresis to prevent cascade: only allow replace if >3 cards on distinct hosts exceed stage-2 within 20m.

here's a quick prometheus query prototype to compute card burst rate (5m):
```
sum by(card_id) (increase(gpu_ecc_correctable_total[5m]))
```
and host aggregation:
```
sum by(host) (increase(gpu_ecc_correctable_total[5m]))
```

mike: APAC capacity is tight atm — cross-region failovers will cost us SLOs for interactive routes. any auto-evac must prefer local soft-drain + opportunistic batching instead of immediate cross-region requeue.
taylor: good point. propose region-aware policy: if spare local capacity < 10% then only soft-drain + telemetry-enrichment and alert to oncall rather than hard-evict.
sophia: for signal fusion i sketched a simple normalized score (pseudo):
```
score = 0.5 * norm(ecc_rate_card) + 0.25 * norm(xid_rate_host) + 0.15 * norm(pci_reset_rate) + 0.1 * norm(driver_disconnects)
if score >= 0.8 -> stage-1 auto soft-drain
if score >= 0.95 -> stage-2 isolate + ops-review
if score >= 1.2 -> stage-3 replace
```
jamie: can we avoid normalization fragility? suggest using percentiles over last 30d per-card baseline so transient noisy cards don't blow up the score.

mike: also capture deployment sensitivity tag — low-latency routes get stricter thresholds, background batch jobs can accept more noisy cards.
ops-bot: created runbook draft: https://runbooks.internal/ecc-fusion-v1 — please add test checklist and rollback steps :thumbsup:

sophia: action items:
- jamie: add percentile baselining to the prometheus queries + example alerts (ETA EOD)
- taylor: draft region-aware gating rules and spare-capacity check (ETA tomorrow)
- mike: enumerate routes we should protect from cross-region failover and add tags to scheduler (ETA 2 days)
- ops-bot: add canary toggle for enabling auto-soft-drain for single host tests

jamie: i'll drop a small canary that only acts on one host pool and emails oncall instead of auto-evict. want to validate no cascade.
sophia: perfect. let's sync after canary results and we can tune score weights. leaving incident open for now so we have a tracked thread.
oncall-bot: incident INC-2024-42 opened for the apac-pool7 ECC spike — assigned to @sophia and @jamie
